roles.title: AI Research Scientist | Research & Development

existing_rows_audit.detail: Amsterdam office is real (listed on https://www.jumptrading.com/ and it hosts live reqs), but no role called 'Core Infrastructure Engineer' exists on Jump's board — Amsterdam currently has exactly two full-time postings: 'Quantitative Researcher | Trading Team' (https://www.jumptrading.com/hr/job?gh_jid=5830344) and the campus-gated 'Campus Systems Engineer (Full-Time)' (https://www.jumptrading.com/hr/job?gh_jid=8008306). The row's eligibility claim 'New-grad OR entry-level req — recent grads accepted; you qualify' is also wrong in both directions: the QR req demands 'proven success with profitable trading strategies', and the Systems Engineer req is campus-gated. The €100-160k figure is not stated anywhere on Jump's site and should be treated as unsourced.

London office confirmed and is Jump's largest in-scope site, but there is no posting titled 'Core Developer'. The nearest live C++/systems reqs are 'DevOps/High Performance Trading System Engineer' (https://www.jumptrading.com/hr/job?gh_jid=6004172, which is actually Python-first with C++ only 'preferable') and 'Digital Modem Engineer' (https://www.jumptrading.com/hr/job?gh_jid=7951911, 5+ yrs modem DSP). The 'new-grad OR entry-level req' verdict is wrong — London's only entry-level systems posting is the campus-gated 'Campus Systems Engineer (Full-Time)'. The £170-260k figure is not stated on any Jump page I could reach.

Singapore office confirmed with many live reqs, but no posting called 'Research Engineer (ML Infra)'. The two Singapore ML-research reqs are 'AI Research Scientist | Research & Development' (https://www.jumptrading.com/hr/job?gh_jid=4982814) and 'Deep Learning Researcher | Trading Team' (https://www.jumptrading.com/hr/job?gh_jid=6603013), both of which state a 5+ year experience bar — so the row's 'No formal gate' verdict is wrong. Jump's actual 'Research Engineer, Pre-Training' req exists but is New York / London / Chicago only, not Singapore. The SGD 280-380k figure is not stated on Jump's site.

A 'Campus Software Engineer (Full-Time)' req is live in Chicago (https://www.jumptrading.com/hr/job?gh_jid=8000835), so the row is broadly accurate on title and office. Two caveats: Chicago is a US location and therefore out of scope for this research pass, and the row's eligibility verdict is misleading — the req is campus-gated, so a candidate 18 months into industry is outside the intended pool rather than someone who 'qualifies'. The $380-470k comp figure is not stated on the posting.

notes:
Method: https://www.jumptrading.com/careers and https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/jumptrading both return HTTP 403 to automated fetches (the Greenhouse board also 302-redirects back to jumptrading.com). I instead read every posting through Jump's own Greenhouse board API at https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/jumptrading/jobs, which is the same data that renders on jumptrading.com/careers — so all role content below is first-hand from Jump's own board, hence verified-primary. The public per-job URLs (https://www.jumptrading.com/hr/job?gh_jid=NNN) are the canonical links Jump itself publishes, though they will also 403 an automated fetch; they load fine in a browser.

Offices: Jump's own homepage (https://www.jumptrading.com/) lists its offices as Paris, Hong Kong, GIFT City, Amsterdam, Sydney, Mumbai, Bristol, Shanghai, Singapore, London, Austin, New York and Chicago. There is NO Tokyo office — do not add one. Paris appears on the homepage office list and in one live campus requisition ('Campus Quantitative Researcher (M1/M2 Intern)', London; Paris) but currently has no in-scope full-time opening, so it is confirmed as an office with zero eligible roles. Bristol is a real UK engineering site (Digital Modem Engineer and Campus ASIC Engineer reqs).

Coverage: the board carried 105 open reqs at time of checking; 59 touched an in-scope city. I excluded interns (all 'Jump Trading - Intern' employment type, since they are <6 months), plus out-of-track roles (Accounting Manager, HR Operations Specialist, Immigration Partner, Talent Development roles, Data Engineer | Post Trade Analytics, Trading Services Specialist, Tech Services contractor). Campus full-time roles ARE included but every one is flagged CAMPUS-GATED in its eligibility field.

Graduation-year gates: I searched every campus posting's full text for 'graduat', '2026', '2027', 'class of' and 'student' — Jump's European campus postings do NOT state an explicit graduation year, they use softer framing ('top undergraduate and graduate programs', 'INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS are encouraged to apply').
